ops.body: Confirmed600KB read-writeback cause: IndexedTasks calls readIndexedQuery, which opens a write transaction and recursively releases the previous active graph during promotion. Main212 traces attribute606208/618496bytes to authority-v2.db in query-after-create/write, with other cache output under1KiB. Draft in query-retirement-nov4 transfers active ownership into one retired-generation slot per binding, drains that slot with the next writer in its existing counter batch, and drains an occupied slot before replacement to keep mixed update sequences bounded. Same active-pin retirement point/cache format, no migrations/timers/background workers. Added real-Bbolt page-root/ownership/cancellation/occupied-slot regression plus existing pinned/reindex/reclamation tests to hosted gate. Root owns; independent outside check required before adopting this algorithm. No local builds/tests/load runs; all25 decisions held.
